decisions.statement: A decision is restated on a part only to narrow what the page above states.
The same words on both narrow nothing, so a part saying them is refused.
A statement is weighed as the page states it, with only the space around it taken off.
The parts a page names are read from the index rather than from the folder.
A page is weighed against the pages it names as parts.
A page is weighed against the pages naming that page as a part.
The part is what a refusal names, whichever of the two pages the change carries.
A refusal names the page above and the words both pages state.
Nothing is judged while this page states `experimental`.
Nothing here reads what a decision means.
A restatement in other words is passed over here, narrowing or not.
Two decisions that contradict each other are passed over, whatever words they use.
Whether a restatement narrows is decided nowhere here.
A statement shared by two pages in no parts relation is passed over.
The kind a decision is stated under is read by nothing here.

definition: the check refusing a decision a page and one of its parts both state word for word
